name: Da Lat
provinceNote: Lam Dong now also includes the former Dak Nong and Binh Thuan provinces, so Mui Ne shares the province on paper.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Da Lat is a cool highland city of pines, lakes, and French-era villas. It is a short flight or a long sleeper from Ho Chi Minh City. Come for the temperature, the market, and the countryside, not for a checklist of themed parks.
fee: The lake and market are free; palaces and parks are ticketed
getThere: Flight to Lien Khuong, then 45 minutes by road, or an overnight bus from Ho Chi Minh City
seoDescription: How to get to Da Lat, what is worth doing in two days, and how the weather differs from the beaches.
intro: Da Lat was built as a hill station and still feels like one: a central lake, a market on a slope, and villas on ridges. Evenings are cool enough for a jacket when the coast is hot.
The countryside of flowers, coffee, and vegetable greenhouses is the better half-day. The amusement-park versions of “Crazy House” are optional.
gettingAround: Lien Khuong Airport is a downhill ride from the city. In town, walk the market and the lake, and use Grab or a taxi for the valleys. EasyRider motorbike tours are common; ride yourself only with the proper license.

stayAreas.name: Around Xuan Huong Lake
stayAreas.summary: Walk to the market and the evening stalls.

eat: Avocado ice cream, hot soy milk, grilled rice paper, and strawberry snacks are the visitor trail. The market is the place to start.
interestsBody: Cool weather, coffee country, and a family stop. It is a poor choice if you wanted a beach and booked the highlands by mistake.

faqs.q: Can you combine Da Lat and Mui Ne?
faqs.a: They share a province after the merger and they are still a long ride apart. Fly or bus each one from Ho Chi Minh City rather than linking them in a day.
